title: +*GENERAL PHYSICS
description: Surveys a broad spectrum of classical and modern physics topics. Develops scientific analysis and problem-solving techniques through study of such topics as kinematics, mechanics, momentum, and energy. Builds models for physical phenomena through qualitative and quantitative observations, comparison with theory in multiple representations, and evaluative sensemaking.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 112Z, 112, 227, 228, 251Z, 251HZ, 251, 251H, 252Z, 252HZ, 252, 252H, 253Z, 253, 254, 255, 256, 264, 265 or minimum score of 075 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 112Z, MTH 112, MTH 227, MTH 228, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251, MTH 251H, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252, MTH 252H, MTH 253Z, MTH 253, MTH 254, MTH 255, MTH 256, MTH 264 and MTH 265.
